title_as_printed: Effects of occupational exposure factors interacting with NLRP3 gene polymorphisms on mild cognitive impairment: A cross-sectional study of workers in an aluminum electrolysis production environment

Task_Type.reason: The study reports odds ratios for MCI by occupational-exposure principal component and NLRP3 genotype, with no classifier. That is a genetic/exposure association (T4); T6 (occupational epidemiology) would also be supportable.
Task_Type.quote: high PC2 exposure significantly increased the odds of MCI [OR (95 % CI): 1.99 (1.36, 2.91)], and the rs10754558 G/C genotype was independently associated with MCI

Category.reason: Genotyping (C3) plus occupational-exposure epidemiology and MoCA (C5). The registry writes the same two codes with a comma instead of a semicolon.
Category.quote: Genotyping of polymorphisms in the NLRP3 gene (rs10754558, rs10925027, rs3806265, rs4612666) was performed.

Validation_Type.reason: No predictive model is fitted; the analyses are logistic association models.
Validation_Type.quote: All analyses were performed using logistic regression models.

Sample_N_Approx.quote: We assessed the cognitive function of 478 workers in a factory in Guangxi, China

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Workers at a single factory in China; ADNI is not used.
ADNI_Dependent.quote: This study involved 478 workers from a large electrolytic aluminum production enterprise in Guangxi Province, China.

notes: Category is written with a comma ('C3,C5') instead of the template's semicolon. litreview_stats.domain() sends every multi-code value to OTHER, so the census is unaffected, but any consumer that splits on ';' would read it as one unknown code. The population is aluminium-electrolysis workers (mean age about 39), with MCI defined as MoCA < 26.
